name: The Printer Whisperer
text: Talked the third-floor printer out of a paper jam using only kind words and a gentle tap. It has never jammed for them since.

name: Captain Standup
text: Once ran a daily standup so efficient it finished before it started. Nobody has been able to reproduce it.

name: The Slack Oracle
text: Replied to a message 0.4 seconds before it was sent. Claims it was just a good guess.

name: Sir Mergealot
text: Resolved a 400-file merge conflict in one go, then calmly went for lunch like nothing happened.

name: Wi-Fi Diviner
text: Can find the one spot in any office with full signal by walking in slow circles, holding a laptop overhead.

name: The Emoji Linguist
text: Wrote an entire project brief in emoji. The client approved it without a single question.

name: Keeper of the Snacks
text: Knows the exact restock day for every snack drawer, and has never once revealed the source.

name: Pixel Hunter
text: Spotted a one-pixel misalignment from across the room during a demo. On a projector. Through a window.
